key_insight: Infinity-Wasserstein distributionally robust PCA admits an exact finite-dimensional reformulation while allowing robustness to change the learned principal subspace.
engineering_relevance: The model offers a principled way to learn dimension-reduction representations under distributional uncertainty rather than relying solely on empirical covariance.
method: Derive an exact reformulation and explicitly construct a worst-case distribution.
Retain samplewise residual information and establish a uniform finite-sample guarantee under a finite fourth-moment assumption.
Solve the nonconvex, nonsmooth problem with an iteratively reweighted majorization-minimization algorithm.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments support computational efficiency and downstream effectiveness, but the abstract provides no datasets, baselines, or quantitative results.
watch_item: The optimization remains nonconvex, so the stated convergence analysis should not be interpreted as a guarantee of global optimality.
paper_title: Infinity-Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Principal Component Analysis: Exact Reformulation, Finite-Sample Guarantee, and Efficient Algorithm
